sara: Quick heads-up — nightly CI shard 42 just went red on hosted API integ. Failing auth + streaming toolcall tests. Test: tests/integration/test_toolcall_stream.py::TestToolcallStream::test_auth_header

sara: failing assertion is 'expected toolcall to complete, got 401 from /api/toolcall during streaming handshake'

ben: Can you paste the failing snippet?

sara: here's the minimal log we saw:
```
[2024-04-26T03:04:12Z] stream-handshake -> POST /api/toolcall 401 
payload: {stream_id: "s-abc", headers: {
  "X-Client-Attrs": "...",
  "Authorization": null
}}
error: kid_not_found
```

ben: interesting — runner shows JWT missing kid. Might be auth proxy dropping header.

ci-bot: triggered rerun: `/rerun shard=42 --quick` (queued) :gear:

kai: @maria FYI — your PR #232 touched header ordering in the client, could be related.

maria: yup I moved Authorization to the end to avoid an earlier proxy stripping empty headers. didn't expect parity issues. link: https://git.redwood/pr/232

ben: repro locally: header exists but order is different, and our legacy auth-proxy parser insists on seeing Authorization before X-Client-Attrs. gross.

sara: if rerun stays red can someone bisect? if it's that PR a revert-hotfix might be fastest.

kai: I'll kick off a quick git-bisect in the morning unless rerun clears. in the meantime can we do a targeted rerun for only the auth/stream/toolcall tests? @ci-bot please.

ci-bot: scheduled targeted rerun: https://ci.redwood/targeted/1724689012/shard42 (started)

ben: thanks. if targeted fails I'll draft a tiny revert PR to put Authorization back earlier in the client. also adding a flaky marker to the test so it doesn't block releases until we fix.

maria: I can standby to approve revert if it unblocks main. sorry for the churn — I'll investigate whether proxy change or my client change is the better long-term fix.

sara: ok team — we'll wait for the targeted run. tagging @kai @ben for follow-ups. thanks :pray:
__note: Generated synthetic Slack thread about CI red on hosted API integration (auth + streaming + toolcall).
